summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Aegon Ltd. reporting the pricing of USD 500 million senior unsecured notes (5.625% coupon, ten-year tenor) to be issued by Aegon Funding Company LLC and guaranteed by Aegon Ltd. Proceeds will fund a concurrent tender offer for certain unregistered subordinated notes and general corporate purposes. The notes are expected to settle on May 7, 2026, and will be listed on the NYSE. The filing discloses a routine debt capital markets transaction and a contemporaneous tender offer for outside-the-U.S. holders. No special-situation event—activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, or liquidation—is discussed.
